title: Who Made the Universe? Science Answers
tags: Does the Universe Need a Creator
does the universe need a creator
description:
Do complexity and beauty in the universe mean that it must have a creator? Many theists argue that the world is too complex to be an accident, using examples like the human eye, galaxies, and natural diversity as proof of intelligent design. But science shows that complexity doesn’t require design. From natural laws repeated over billions of years to evolution by natural selection, everything we see can emerge without invoking a supernatural being.

This video dismantles the “complexity requires a creator” claim by showing how creation myths arose out of fear and awe, why explaining a mystery with another mystery isn’t an explanation, and how arguments like the design of the eye betray a misunderstanding of evolution. If you’ve searched for does the universe need a creator, intelligent design vs science, complexity in nature explained, human eye design flaws, or science vs God debate, this video gives you the rational perspective.

Don’t forget to subscribe, like, comment, and share — hype this video so it reaches more people and sparks better conversations!
